# Vision Energy International

> Established in 2018 with more than 160 projects completed, Vision Energy International is a UAE engineering specialist and supplier focused primarily on Lightning Protection Systems and Earthing & Grounding Networks (IEC 62305, BS EN 62305, BS EN 62561, NF C 17-102, BS 7430, NFPA 780), alongside secondary project supply and technical support for Commercial Gym Equipment and Laboratory Equipment across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, the UAE, and Qatar.

## Company Overview & Geographic Scope
- **Legal Entity**: VISION ENERGY INTERNATIONAL
- **Head Office**: RAK Business Centre BC4, RAK FTZ Business Park, P.O Box 17111, Al Nakheel, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE
- **Branches**: Dubai and Abu Dhabi (UAE)
- **Markets Served**: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, wider UAE, and Qatar (project supply & technical support; no local office in Qatar)
- **UAE Authorities Referenced**: DEWA, SEWA, Etihad WE, ADDC, DoE (Department of Energy), ADCDA (Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority), Abu Dhabi Municipality
- **Primary Contact**: `+971 7 204 2763` | `+971 54 700 4616` | `info@visionenergyme.com`

## Priority #1 Technical Expertise
- [Engineering Expertise Hub](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise): Overview hub linking all four engineering and equipment disciplines, standards compliance matrix, and technical FAQ.
- [Lightning Protection Engineering Guide](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise/lightning): Dedicated guide covering formation, risk levels I–IV, Rolling Sphere, Protection Angle, Meshed Cage, ESE NF C 17-102, UAE/Qatar application, and safety precautions.
- [Earthing & Grounding Engineering Guide](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise/earthing): Dedicated guide covering Wenner soil resistivity testing, deep copper electrodes, exothermic joints, Type 1/2/3 SPD coordination, and 10-stage delivery workflow.
- [Markdown Specification of /expertise](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise.md): Agent-friendly Markdown reference with all protection tables, formulas (`Rp`, `Rp(h)`, Rolling Sphere Levels I–IV, Faraday Mesh grid dimensions, ESE `ΔT` radii), 10-stage delivery workflow, and direct FAQ answers.

## Priority #2 Facility & Equipment Expertise
- [Commercial Gym & Sports Equipment Guide](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise/gym): Commercial fitness & athletic accessories (`SP-01`, `SP-02`) procurement schedules and technical specifications across the UAE & Qatar.
- [Laboratory Equipment & Instrumentation Guide](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise/laboratory): Analytical instruments (`AT`), benchtop gear (`LE`), safety cabinets (`LS`), glassware (`LG`), cold storage (`TS`), water systems (`WS`), and PPE (`LPE`) across the UAE & Qatar.

## Core Catalog & Services
- [All Product Categories](https://www.visionenergyme.com/products): Lightning protection hardware, earthing rods/tapes/exothermic moulds, electrical distribution, LED lighting, industrial automation, safety PPE, laboratory consumables, and gym equipment.
- [Engineering & Manpower Services](https://www.visionenergyme.com/services): Engineering design, soil resistivity testing, system commissioning, and specialist technical manpower.
- [Technical Blog](https://www.visionenergyme.com/blog): Articles on surge arrester placement, high-resistivity earthing, and Conventional vs. ESE design.
- [Request a Quote / Contact](https://www.visionenergyme.com/contact): Direct project submittal and procurement enquiry page.
